title: JUnit reports from node --test are read: pass, fail and skip per test, nested suites, entities; a file that is not JUnit is refused
Ledger rows are validated on load and a key in two files is refused
--gate-phase N fails while any row of phase N or earlier is not covered, fixed or a reviewed wont
A row whose profile entry disappears is marked orphaned, never deleted, and the parity check fails until reviewed
Every row in the profiles' limitation and capability sections is in the ledger; the seeded files match a fresh seed
Status is computed from the lanes' reports: covered needs a passing positive and negative test on every platform the row names; a skip counts as not run
Any failing test tagged with a row's key makes the row regressed and fails the check
A test tagged with a key no row has fails the check
One grader for every arm: claims block only, vocabulary normalised, refuted and out-of-set claims penalised, labels graded, duplicates counted once

The harness runs cells one at a time in fresh workspaces and records transcript, model, digests, tool versions, turns, tool calls, token split, time and timeouts; the fake arm exercises it with no model
Oracle facts come from LLVM's tools, not reax; the committed tasks match a fresh LLVM run
30 benchmark tasks over the fixture corpus, subjects pinned by digest, with refuted facts to avoid and an adversarial task
Every committed fixture has the size and SHA-256 its manifest records; a changed, missing or unlisted file is reported
Rebuilding the corpus with the pinned zig at the fixed build root gives byte-identical files; a different zig version is refused
Every fixture's header matches its target (container format, machine, word size); the fat and PE helpers refuse other input
One operation registry generates docs/operations.md, the tool catalog and the ledger mapping; every documented example runs as a test; a mapping to an unknown or doubly covered row is refused
